item.title: 📍 Meeting the challenges of the times: we continue to strengthen CSTO's force capabilities
item.description: Meeting the challenges of the times: we continue to strengthen CSTO's force capabilities Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov took part in a joint meeting of the Council of Ministers of Foreign Affairs, the Council of Ministers of Defence, and the Committee of Secretaries of Security Councils of the Collective Security Treaty Organisation. 📍 Moscow 💬 The officials discussed ▫️ the military and political situation in the CSTO collective security regions, ▫️ the state and prospects of the global and regional security sphere, ▫️ implementation of the priorities of the Russian Federation's chairmanship over the Organisation this year. ✅ The session took a number of joint decisions aimed at strengthening the CSTO's force capabilities. 🤝 At the end of the joint meeting, the participants reviewed the Organization’s activities during the intersessional period and planned events for the upcoming year. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against energy infrastructure facilities, logistics centres of Ukraine, and ves
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against energy infrastructure facilities, logistics centres of Ukraine, and vessels involved in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 This afternoon, as a result of the strikes, they hit: ▫️ two 330 kV and 110 kV power substations , which provided support for enterprises of the Ukrainian defence industry in Nezhin and Sosnitsa (Chernigov region); ▫️ the Epicentr logistics centre , where military cargo was stored and distributed in Kirovograd (Kropivnitsky); ▫️ a dry cargo ship with weapons and military equipment for the Armed Forces of Ukraine in the Black Sea, 7 km south-western of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 We block roads, cut off reserves A storming soldier with the call sign 'Dobro' told about the liberation of Vasilkovoye
item.description: We block roads, cut off reserves 💬 A storming soldier with the call sign 'Dobro' told about the liberation of Vasilkovoye in Zaporozhye region. ▫️ According to the servicemember, assault groups moved from different directions through a treeline, moving under drone fire on the way to well-built positions on the highgrounds. 👊 After seizing the village, the servicemen mopped up all enemy's foxholes and held the lines till the consolidation group arrived. 🚩 The liberation of Vasilkovoye made it possible to block supply routes and the approach of AFU reserves. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 Through hardships to rescue Servicemen of the 5th Separate Commandant's Regiment (Tsentr Group of Forces) evacuated civilians from Belitskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
item.description: Through hardships to rescue Servicemen of the 5th Separate Commandant's Regiment (Tsentr Group of Forces) evacuated civilians from Belitskoye (Donetsk People's Republic). People had been hiding in the basements for long time and waited for Russian servicemen avoiding contact with militants. 📍 While making up an evacuation plan, the regiment's command took into account the current situation and chose a way to use natural covers in the area like treelines and ravines. 🤝 The evacuation was successful . People are now in a safe zone. There, they have been provided with the necessary assistance and accommodation. ❤️ Our warriors are the best. They risked their lives and once again proved that we leave no one behind. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30527

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
As a result of active actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces liberated Nikolskoye in Sumy region.
💥
Formations of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Sumy and Putivl (Sumy region).
🔥
In addition,
strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade near Rubezhnoye, Veseloye, Liptsy, and Izbitskoye (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 305 troops, an armoured fighting vehicle, 15 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line
. Manpower and materiel of three mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Izyum, Volchiy Yar, Berezovka (Kharkov region), Mayaki, and Ilyichovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 210 servicemen, an armoured fighting vehicle, 13 motor vehicles, five artillery guns, and seven electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Russian units inflicted damage on formations of two mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an assault brigade, and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Raygorodok, Nikolayevka, and Krasny Molochar (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 190 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 21 motor vehicles, and one self-propelled artillery system.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation
. Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades close to Yakovlevka, Sergeyevka, Kuritsino, Roganskoye, Novopavlovka, Kamenka, and Verovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 340 troops, eight armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, and two electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced into the depth of the enemy's defence
. Manpower and hardware of three air assault brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a marine brigade have been hit near Malinovka, Ivanovka, Kolomiytsy (Dnepropetrovsk region), Tavriyskoye, Novorozovka, and Novonikolayevka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 215 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and three motor vehicles.
